description: Curated additions and suppressions for facts that cannot be interpreted safely from source data. Entity keys use the stable IDs emitted by recommendation_catalog_v3.json.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphonE.reason: Siphon Elements creates Infusion Remnants only after the player Freezes, Shocks, or Ignites a target; the trigger text does not make Siphon Elements an ailment applicator.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTameBea.reason: Tame Beast transforms after a rare Beast capture and then summons that Beast as a reviving Companion.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRhoaMo.reason: Rhoa Mount explicitly requires wielding a Bow or Spear even though the retained equipment record is unrestricted.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPo.reason: Pounce triggers Predator's Mark; its activation triggers the nested Summon Wolf skill, which creates a Wolf Minion.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLivin.reason: Living Lightning creates temporary Minions when the supported skill deals Lightning damage.
Living Lightning II creates temporary Minions when the supported skill deals Lightning damage.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBreac.reason: Breachlord's Rift only breaks Armour when the supported skill Freezes or Electrocutes; those prerequisites must remain attached to the application fact.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrit.reason: Brittle Armour only breaks Armour against enemies Frozen by the supported skill.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorr.reason: Corrosion breaks Armour through Poison applied by the supported skill, so Poison is a prerequisite rather than independent Armour Break application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEter.reason: Eternal Flame modifies existing Ignites; it does not independently grant Ignite application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemFire.reason: Fire Exposure applies Exposure when the supported skill Ignites; it does not independently grant Ignite application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemFros.reason: Frost Nexus creates Chilled Ground around enemies Frozen by the supported skill, so Freeze is a prerequisite for its Chill route.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemLigh.reason: Lightning Exposure applies Exposure when the supported skill Shocks; it does not independently grant Shock application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemOutma.reason: Outmaneuver only breaks Armour against Parried enemies.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemOlro.reason: Olroth's Hubris allows Physical damage to contribute to Freeze buildup; the supported skill does not gain unconditional Freeze application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnve.reason: Poison III strengthens Poison against Bleeding enemies; its Bleed reference is a target condition, not Bleed application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCour.reason: Shock Conduction spreads an existing Shock and does not independently create the first Shock.
Shock Conduction II spreads an existing Shock or Shocks Drenched enemies; it does not independently create the first Shock without either state.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemShock.reason: Shocking Leap creates Shocked Ground only after the supported skill Critically Hits, so it is not unconditional Shock application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSpre.reason: Spreading Frost Chills nearby enemies after the supported skill Freezes; it neither grants Freeze nor provides unconditional Chill.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemThri.reason: Thrill of the Kill II grants Shock chance only after culling an already Shocked enemy; it does not independently create the first Shock.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTulsS.reason: Tul's Stillness allows Chaos damage to contribute to Freeze buildup; its unconditional provision is Chaos damage, not Freeze application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSkitt.reason: Skittering Stone I releases stone Minions from shatterable earthen objects created by the supported skill.
Skittering Stone II releases stone Minions from shatterable earthen objects created by the supported skill.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemLace.reason: Bleed IV explicitly prevents the supported skill from inflicting Bleed; its Bleed reference describes a target condition, not application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemLast.reason: Lasting Shock reduces the supported skill's existing Shock application frequency and extends duration; it does not provide Shock application.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellT.reason: Spell Totem is a complete active package only when paired with an eligible socketed Spell.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncest.reason: Ancestral Warrior Totem requires an eligible socketed Mace attack as its damage payload.

skill:Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMortarC.reason: Mortar Cannon requires an eligible socketed Grenade skill as its damage payload.
